assumptions.choice: Daily closes are derived from the final 5-minute close of each trading day, and RSI(14) uses Wilder smoothing.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only a 5-minute feed.

assumptions.choice: The RSI value completed at the prior trading day's close determines whether the current trading day is eligible.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal reading of 'daily RSI(14) at the close of the previous day'.

assumptions.choice: SMA-cross signals use 5-minute closing prices and are evaluated at each bar close.
assumptions.reason: OHLCV data provides no more granular crossing sequence.

assumptions.choice: The forced-exit signal is evaluated on the 15:45 timestamped 5-minute bar.
assumptions.reason: This is the available bar timestamp 15 minutes before the 16:00 session close.

assumptions.choice: Order quantity equals 5% of current broker portfolio value divided by the signal-bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification states 5% of capital but does not define capital valuation or share rounding.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit orders are created after the entry order fills, using its actual execution price and linked OCO.
assumptions.reason: The specified percentages are from the entry price.
